'''Ramie''' is an [[aboveground]] [[crop]]. Once harvested, ramie plants may be [[plant processing|processed]] at a [[farmer's workshop]] to produce ramie plant fiber [[thread]], or milled into slurry for ramie [[paper]].

Some [[dwarves]] [[Preferences|like]] ramie plants for their ''useful stems''.
